title: Baggage
summary: What you can bring is set by the fare you pick, and every fare says so in six lines before you pay.

title: Refunds and exchanges
summary: Whether a ticket can be changed or given back is fixed by the fare when it is bought, not decided afterwards.

title: Ticket did not arrive
summary: The booking exists from the moment you see a reference. The email is a copy of it, not the ticket itself.

title: Changing passenger details
summary: Names are checked against the document you travel on, so checkout is the moment to get them right.

title: Flying with children
summary: Whether a child gets a seat of their own decides both what they pay and how many of you can travel together.
